node.title: Re^4: Is foreach split Optimized?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Thank you [stevieb|Steve] and [Laurent_R|Laurent]! It seems that I was testing on one of the few versions of Perl where the filehandle version is a bit slower. It does make sense that the filehandle version is faster, considering that it [id://1194799|doesn't actually split the string] (and [doc://$/] being a fixed string instead of a regex might contribute a little bit). So I think the filehandle version is clearly the best :-)
